fusions.name: Scent Followed
fusions.desc: Hurls a lump that deals 8 damage to the first enemy it meets and heals you for 20% of the damage dealt. Usable only on an enemy carrying one of your afflictions, and uses one of them up.

fusions.name: Frenzy Finish
fusions.desc: A blow that deals 16 damage and draws out every affliction you have on the target, dealing 60% more damage for each one drawn. It leaves the target 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Closing Circles
fusions.desc: Increases your damage by 35% for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Taste for Weakness
fusions.desc: Against enemies carrying your afflictions, you deal 15% more damage.
